high_level_description: The image depicts a woman standing on a red carpet at the MTV Video Music Awards (VMA). She is wearing a glamorous, light pink satin dress with a corset-style bodice that features intricate silver lacing down the front. The dress has a high slit on one side, revealing her leg. Her hair is styled in loose waves, cascading over her shoulders. The background is a dark blue wall with the MTV logo prominently displayed in white and red. The text "MTV VIDEO MUSIC AWARDS" is visible in the top left corner of the image. Additional text on the right side of the image provides details about her outfit
